**3.4** A Confirmation shall, upon delivery, supplement, form part of, and be subject to this Agreement. Together with this Agreement, each Confirmation shall evidence a complete and binding agreement between the parties with respect to the Transaction to which it relates. In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of a Confirmation and the terms of this Agreement (including Annex I and Annex II), the terms of the Confirmation shall prevail with respect to the Transaction to which such Confirmation relates, unless the Confirmation expressly provides otherwise.

**3.5** The failure by either party to deliver a Confirmation with respect to a Transaction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of that Transaction, provided that the terms thereof have been agreed between the parties. Where a Confirmation is not delivered by the deadline specified in Paragraph 3.2, the Transaction shall nonetheless be valid and governed by this Agreement, and either party may require the other to deliver a Confirmation at any time thereafter.

**3.6** A Confirmation may be delivered by electronic mail (including as a PDF attachment), and a Confirmation so delivered shall have the same force and effect as a signed original.

**[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 4(a) --- Margin Deficit / Margin Excess**

**4.1** The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.2** If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Deficit**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.3** If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Excess**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.

**Paragraph 4(b) --- Delivery Amount / Return Amount**

**4.4** Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a \"**Margin Call**\") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Delivery Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).

**4.5** Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a \"**Margin Call**\") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Return Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being \$500,000 as of the date hereof).

**4.6** Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.

**Paragraph 4(c) --- Margin Call Timing**

**4.7** A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.

**4.8** If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.

**4.9** If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.

**4.10** For the purposes of this Paragraph 4(c), a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" when it is actually received by the recipient at the address, facsimile number, or electronic mail address specified in Annex II, Section 14 for the giving of notices. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.

**Paragraph 4(d) --- Haircuts**

**4.11** The applicable Haircut Percentage for each category of Eligible Collateral is as specified in Annex II, Section 4, and is summarised as follows:

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Category**                        **Haircut Percentage**
  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  Eligible Sovereign Securities       1.5% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\")

  Eligible Corporate Securities       3.5% (the \"Corporate Haircut\")
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

**4.12** The Transaction Exposure in respect of any Transaction shall be calculated by applying the relevant Haircut Percentage to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities. The Haircut Percentage shall be applied in the manner set out in Annex II, Section 4, such that the Purchase Price for a Transaction shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of the Purchased Securities by one (1) plus the applicable Haircut Percentage (expressed as a decimal).

Buyer\'s obligation to make the Manufactured Payment is an independent obligation under this Agreement and shall not be conditional upon Buyer\'s receipt of the underlying Income.

**[Paragraph 7 --- Netting of Obligations]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 7(a) --- Payment Netting**

**7.1** The standard payment netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would be payable by each party to the other in the same currency and on the same value date, the mutual obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount. Such single net payment shall be made by the party owing the net amount on the relevant value date in the manner specified in Paragraph 6(a).

**Paragraph 7(b) --- Close-out Netting / Settlement Netting**

**7.2** **Elected.** If on any day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and in respect of the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether pursuant to Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance), Paragraph 5 (Income Payments), Paragraph 10 (Events of Default), or otherwise under this Agreement), the obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount.

**7.3** The single net amount determined in accordance with Paragraph 7.2 above shall be payable in the relevant currency on the relevant settlement date, and only the net amount shall be required to be paid by the party owing such amount. The other party shall have no obligation to make any payment in respect of the amounts so netted.

**7.4** Each party represents that the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7 are enforceable against it in all relevant jurisdictions, including the jurisdiction of its incorporation or organisation, the jurisdiction of its principal office, and any other jurisdiction in which it conducts business or holds assets. / Margin Excess**

**4.1** The parties shall, on each Business Day (or at such other intervals as may be agreed), mark to market all outstanding Transactions by reference to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities and the Transaction Exposure in respect of each Transaction, each calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.2** If at any time the aggregate Cash Margin (if any) held by or on behalf of Buyer, together with the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), is less than the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Deficit**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Deficit shall be equal to the shortfall, calculated in the Base Currency.

**4.3** If at any time the aggregate Market Value of all Purchased Securities held by Buyer (adjusted by the application of the relevant Haircut Percentage), together with any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer, exceeds the aggregate Transaction Exposure of Buyer with respect to all Transactions then outstanding, a \"**Margin Excess**\" shall be deemed to exist. The amount of such Margin Excess shall be equal to the surplus, calculated in the Base Currency.

**Paragraph 4(b) --- Delivery Amount / Return Amount**

**4.4** Upon the existence of a Margin Deficit, Buyer may by notice to Seller (a \"**Margin Call**\") require Seller to transfer to Buyer Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) in an amount sufficient to eliminate such Margin Deficit (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Delivery Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Delivery Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(a) (being \$250,000 as of the date hereof).

**4.5** Upon the existence of a Margin Excess, Seller may by notice to Buyer (also a \"**Margin Call**\") require Buyer to transfer to Seller Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin (or any combination thereof) sufficient to eliminate such Margin Excess (the aggregate amount so required, the \"**Return Amount**\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no transfer shall be required if the Return Amount would be less than or equal to the applicable Margin Threshold specified in Annex II, Section 5(b) (being \$250,000 as of the date hereof).

**4.6** Any Additional Purchased Securities transferred by Seller to Buyer pursuant to a Margin Call must constitute Eligible Collateral, and the Market Value of such Additional Purchased Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) shall be at least equal to the Delivery Amount.

**Paragraph 4(c) --- Margin Call Timing**

**4.7** A Margin Call must be received by the other party by the margin call cut-off time specified in Annex II, Section 7 (being 10:00 a.m. London time as of the date hereof) in order for the resulting transfer to be required on that same Business Day.

**4.8** If a Margin Call is received before the cut-off time on a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on that same Business Day.

**4.9** If a Margin Call is received at or after the cut-off time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the party receiving the Margin Call shall make the required transfer on the next following Business Day.

**4.10** For the purposes of this Paragraph 4(c), a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" when it is actually received by the recipient at the address, facsimile number, or electronic mail address specified in Annex II, Section 14 for the giving of notices. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.

**Paragraph 4(d) --- Haircuts**

**4.11** The applicable Haircut Percentage for each category of Eligible Collateral is as specified in Annex II, Section 4, and is summarised as follows:

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Category**                        **Haircut Percentage**
  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  Eligible Sovereign Securities       2.0% (the \"Sovereign Haircut\")

  Eligible Corporate Securities       5.0% (the \"Corporate Haircut\")
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

**4.12** The Transaction Exposure in respect of any Transaction shall be calculated by applying the relevant Haircut Percentage to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities. The Haircut Percentage shall be applied in the manner set out in Annex II, Section 4, such that the Purchase Price for a Transaction shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of the Purchased Securities by one (1) plus the applicable Haircut Percentage (expressed as a decimal).

**4.13** Buyer reserves the right, upon not less than five (5) Business Days\' prior written notice to Seller, to revise the applicable Haircut Percentage for any category of Eligible Collateral in connection with future Transactions, provided that (a) any such revision shall apply only to Transactions entered into after the effective date of such revision and shall not affect the terms of any Transaction already outstanding, and (b) any such revision shall be made in good faith and on a commercially reasonable basis, having regard to prevailing market conditions, the credit quality of the relevant class of securities, and Buyer\'s internal risk management policies.

**[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**

**5.1** Where Purchased Securities are held by Buyer on a record date, ex-dividend date, or other relevant date for any distribution of Income (including, without limitation, any coupon, interest payment, dividend, principal repayment (other than at maturity), or other distribution payable in respect of such Purchased Securities), Buyer shall, on the next Business Day following the date on which Buyer receives or is credited with such Income, pay to Seller an amount equal to such Income (a \"**Manufactured Payment**\").

**5.2** Manufactured Payments shall be made in the currency in which the relevant Income payment is denominated and shall be paid to the account designated by Seller for the receipt of funds in such currency, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise notified by Seller to Buyer in writing.

**5.3** All Manufactured Payments shall be made net of any applicable withholding tax, deduction, or other amount required to be withheld or deducted by Buyer under applicable law. If Buyer is required by applicable law to make any such withholding or deduction, the provisions of Paragraph 11 (Tax) shall apply with respect to any obligation of Buyer to gross up such payment.

**5.4** For the avoidance of doubt, the obligation to make a Manufactured Payment arises regardless of whether Buyer has actually received the relevant Income payment from the issuer of the Purchased Securities. Buyer\'s obligation to make the Manufactured Payment is an independent obligation under this Agreement and shall not be conditional upon Buyer\'s receipt of the underlying Income.

**[Paragraph 6 --- Payment and Transfer]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 6(a) --- Method**

**6.1** All payments of cash required to be made under this Agreement shall be made in immediately available, freely transferable, same-day funds in the relevant currency to the account specified by the receiving party in the relevant Confirmation, in Annex II, Section 14, or as otherwise notified by the receiving party to the paying party in writing from time to time.

**6.2** All transfers of Securities required to be made under this Agreement (including the initial transfer of Purchased Securities, the transfer of Additional Purchased Securities, the return of Equivalent Securities, and the transfer of Alternative Securities upon substitution) shall be made through the applicable settlement system, as follows:

> \(a\) For Euro-denominated Eligible Collateral: **Clearstream Banking S.A.**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of Clearstream Banking S.A. as in effect from time to time.
>
> \(b\) For USD-denominated Eligible Collateral: **The Depository Trust Company (DTC)**, in accordance with the rules and procedures of DTC as in effect from time to time.

**6.3** Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses in connection with the settlement of Securities through the applicable settlement system, including any fees or charges imposed by the settlement system operator, the relevant custodian, or any intermediary in the settlement chain, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties.

**6.4** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties for a specific Transaction, all deliveries of Securities shall be made on a delivery-versus-payment (DvP) basis. If DvP settlement is not available or practicable for a particular Transaction, the parties shall agree in advance on an alternative delivery mechanism and shall cooperate in good faith to minimise settlement risk.

**Paragraph 6(b) --- Netting**

**6.5** As elected in Annex II, Section 8, Paragraph 7(b) of this Agreement (settlement netting for obligations in the same currency falling due on the same settlement date) shall apply. The parties agree that, where on any Business Day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and on the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether under Paragraph 4, Paragraph 5, or otherwise under this Agreement), such obligations shall be subject to the netting provisions set out in Paragraph 7 below.

**[Paragraph 7 --- Netting of Obligations]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 7(a) --- Payment Netting**

**7.1** The standard payment netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would be payable by each party to the other in the same currency and on the same value date, the mutual obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount. Such single net payment shall be made by the party owing the net amount on the relevant value date in the manner specified in Paragraph 6(a).

**Paragraph 7(b) --- Close-out Netting / Settlement Netting**

**7.2** **Elected.** If on any day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and in respect of the same settlement date by each party to the other (whether pursuant to Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance), Paragraph 5 (Income Payments), Paragraph 10 (Events of Default), or otherwise under this Agreement), the obligations of each party to make any such payment shall be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount.

**7.3** The single net amount determined in accordance with Paragraph 7.2 above shall be payable in the relevant currency on the relevant settlement date, and only the net amount shall be required to be paid by the party owing such amount. The other party shall have no obligation to make any payment in respect of the amounts so netted.

**7.4** Each party represents that the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7 are enforceable against it in all relevant jurisdictions, including the jurisdiction of its incorporation or organisation, the jurisdiction of its principal office, and any other jurisdiction in which it conducts business or holds assets. Each party agrees to take such steps and execute such documents as may reasonably be required to give effect to the netting provisions of this Paragraph 7.

**[Paragraph 8 --- Substitution]{.underline}**

**8.1** Subject to the provisions of Annex II, Section 9, Seller may from time to time during the term of any Transaction request the substitution of Alternative Securities for all or any part of the Purchased Securities in that Transaction.

**8.2** Any request for substitution shall be made by Seller to Buyer in writing (including by electronic mail) and shall specify the Purchased Securities to be replaced, the proposed Alternative Securities, and the proposed date on which the substitution is to take effect. The request shall include sufficient detail regarding the proposed Alternative Securities (including ISIN, nominal amount, issuer, coupon, maturity, and credit rating) to enable Buyer to evaluate the request.

**8.3** **Buyer\'s prior written consent is required** for any substitution. Buyer may grant, withhold, condition, or delay such consent in its sole and absolute discretion. Buyer shall not be required to provide any reason for any refusal of a request for substitution. Buyer shall use reasonable efforts to respond to any request for substitution within two (2) Business Days of receipt, but any failure to respond within such period shall not constitute consent.

**8.4** Where Buyer has given its consent, the substitution shall be effected on the Business Day agreed by the parties (or, failing agreement, on the second Business Day following the date of Buyer\'s consent) by the simultaneous transfer of the Alternative Securities by Seller to Buyer (or to Buyer\'s account at the relevant settlement system) and the transfer of the relevant Purchased Securities by Buyer to Seller (or to Seller\'s account at the relevant settlement system), in each case in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 6.

**8.5** Any Alternative Securities transferred by Seller must qualify as Eligible Collateral and must satisfy all of the eligibility criteria set out in Annex II, Section 3. The Market Value of the Alternative Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) must be at least equal to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) as of the close of business on the Business Day immediately preceding the substitution date.

**8.6** Upon completion of a substitution, the Alternative Securities shall become the Purchased Securities for all purposes of the relevant Transaction, and the Confirmation for such Transaction shall be deemed to have been amended accordingly.

**[Paragraph 9 --- Representations]{.underline}**

**9.1** Each party represents and warrants to the other, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date on which it enters into a Transaction, that:

> \(a\) **Due Organisation and Authority.** It is duly organised, validly existing, and in good standing (or the equivalent) under the laws of its jurisdiction of incorporation or organisation. It has the full power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform its obligations under this Agreement and each Transaction, and has taken all necessary corporate, regulatory, or other action to authorise such execution, delivery, and performance.
>
> \(b\) **No Violation.** The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction do not and will not (i) violate or conflict with any provision of its constitutional or organisational documents (including, without limitation, its memorandum and articles of association, certificate of formation, limited liability company agreement, partnership agreement, or equivalent documents), (ii) violate or conflict with any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, or decree of any governmental authority or regulatory body having jurisdiction over it, or (iii) result in a breach of, or constitute a default under, any agreement, instrument, or obligation to which it is a party or by which it or any of its assets may be bound.
>
> \(c\) **Governmental and Regulatory Approvals.** All governmental and regulatory consents, approvals, authorisations, registrations, filings, and notices that are necessary for the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and each Transaction have been obtained or made and are in full force and effect.
>
> \(d\) **Binding Obligations.** This Agreement and each Transaction constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations of such party, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to equitable principles of general applicability.
>
> \(e\) **No Litigation.** There is no pending or, to the best of its knowledge, threatened action, suit, proceeding, inquiry, or investigation before or by any court, tribunal, governmental authority, or regulatory body which would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction, or which questions the validity or enforceability of this Agreement or any Transaction.
>
> \(f\) **Accuracy of Information.** All information furnished by it to the other party in connection with this Agreement and each Transaction is true, accurate, and complete in all material respects as of the date on which such information is furnished, and it is not aware of any fact or circumstance that has not been disclosed to the other party and that might reasonably be expected to materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement or any Transaction.

**9.2** **Additional Seller Representation.** Meridian Capital Securities LLC represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly registered as a broker-dealer with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under Section 15 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and is a member in good standing of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), CRD# 298417. Seller further represents that its registration and membership are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on its registration or membership that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of the SEC and FINRA.

**9.3** **Additional Buyer Representation.** Voss Bank AG represents and warrants, as of the date of this Agreement and as of each Purchase Date, that it is duly authorised and regulated as a bank by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) with its registered head office at Talstrasse 62, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland, and that its London Branch is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and subject to regulation by the Financial Conduct Authority and limited regulation by the Prudential Regulation Authority, FCA Firm Reference Number 487203. Buyer further represents that all such authorisations are in full force and effect, that it is not subject to any suspension, revocation, or restriction on any such authorisation that would materially affect its ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement, and that it is in compliance in all material respects with all applicable requirements of FINMA, the PRA, and the FCA.

**[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 10(a) --- Standard Events of Default**

**10.1** Each of the following shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):

> \(i\) **Failure to Pay or Deliver.** Such party fails to pay any amount or deliver any Securities when due under this Agreement or any Transaction (including, without limitation, any Purchase Price, Repurchase Price, Cash Margin, Manufactured Payment, or margin transfer), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party.
>
> \(ii\) **Failure to Comply with Margin Call.** Such party fails to comply with a Margin Call made in accordance with Paragraph 4 (including any failure to transfer Additional Purchased Securities, Equivalent Securities, or Cash Margin in the amount and by the time required), and such failure continues for a period of one (1) Business Day after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party.
>
> \(iii\) **Breach of Representation.** Any representation or warranty made or deemed repeated by such party under Paragraph 9 (or elsewhere in this Agreement) is materially incorrect or misleading when made or when deemed repeated.
>
> \(iv\) **Failure to Perform Other Obligations.** Such party fails to perform any other material obligation under this Agreement and, if such failure is capable of remedy, such failure continues for thirty (30) calendar days after the Non-Defaulting Party gives written notice of such failure to the Defaulting Party specifying the nature of the failure and requiring its remedy.
>
> \(v\) **Act of Insolvency.** An Act of Insolvency occurs with respect to such party, as defined in the 2011 ICMA GMRA and as supplemented by Annex II, Section 11.
>
> \(vi\) **Cross-Default.** A Cross-Default occurs with respect to such party, as defined and supplemented by Annex II, Section 10.

**Paragraph 10(b) --- Consequences of an Event of Default**

**10.2** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default with respect to a Defaulting Party, the Non-Defaulting Party may, at any time thereafter, by written notice to the Defaulting Party (or, in the case of an Act of Insolvency, without the requirement for any notice if the Act of Insolvency constitutes an ipso facto trigger as set out in Annex II, Section 11(b)), designate an \"**Early Termination Date**\" in respect of all (but not less than all) outstanding Transactions.

**10.3** Upon designation of an Early Termination Date, no further payments or deliveries shall be required to be made by either party in respect of any Transaction, other than the net amount (if any) determined in accordance with the close-out and netting provisions of this Paragraph 10.

**10.4** The standard close-out netting provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. The Default Market Value of each Transaction shall be determined in accordance with Paragraph 10(d) of the 2011 ICMA GMRA, and the amounts so determined shall be aggregated and netted in accordance with the provisions thereof to produce a single net amount payable by one party to the other. The party owing such net amount shall pay it to the other party on the Early Termination Date (or, if such date is not a Business Day, on the next following Business Day) in the Base Currency.

**10.5** The rights and remedies of the Non-Defaulting Party under this Paragraph 10 are in addition to, and without prejudice to, any other rights or remedies available to it under this Agreement, at law, or in equity.

**[Paragraph 11 --- Tax]{.underline}**

**Paragraph 11(a) --- General Tax Provisions**

**11.1** The standard tax provisions of the 2011 ICMA GMRA shall apply. Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations arising in connection with this Agreement and any Transaction, and each party shall provide to the other party such tax forms, certificates, and other documentation as the other party may reasonably request in order to establish any available exemption from, or reduction in the rate of, any withholding or deduction for or on account of tax.

**11.2** Each party represents that it has provided, or will provide promptly upon request, accurate and complete information regarding its tax status, residency, and any applicable tax identification numbers to the other party, and will promptly notify the other party of any change in such information.

**Paragraph 11(b) --- Tax Gross-Up**

**11.3** **Elected.** If either party (the \"**Tax Payor**\") is required by any applicable law, regulation, or governmental or regulatory authority to make any deduction or withholding from any payment due under this Agreement (including, without limitation, any Manufactured Payment, any payment of the Purchase Price or the Repurchase Price, any payment of Cash Margin, or any payment of a close-out amount), the Tax Payor shall pay such additional amounts (the \"**Tax Gross-Up Amounts**\") as may be necessary to ensure that the other party (the \"**Tax Payee**\") receives the full amount that it would have received had no such deduction or withholding been required.

**11.4** The Tax Payor\'s obligation to pay Tax Gross-Up Amounts shall not apply to the extent that the deduction or withholding arises as a result of (a) the Tax Payee\'s failure *

The Base Currency for all purposes under this Agreement shall be **United States Dollars (USD)**. All calculations required to be made under this Agreement in a single currency (including calculations of Transaction Exposure, Margin Deficit, Margin Excess, Net Exposure, Delivery Amount, Return Amount, and Default Market Value) shall be made in, or converted into, the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange prevailing at the relevant time of determination, as reasonably determined by Buyer.

**Section 3 --- Eligible Collateral**

**(a) \"Eligible Sovereign Securities\"** means fixed-rate or floating-rate debt securities denominated in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, or CHF and issued by the central government (or a central government-guaranteed agency) of any of the following G7 nations: the **United States of America**, the **United Kingdom**, **Germany** (Bundesrepublik Deutschland), **France** (République française), **Japan**, **Canada**, and **Italy** (Repubblica Italiana), provided that:

> \(i\) such securities have a long-term issuer credit rating of not less than **A--** by S&P Global Ratings (\"**S&P**\") or **A3** by Moody\'s Investors Service (\"**Moody\'s**\") (or, if rated by both, meeting at least one such threshold at the relevant time of determination);
>
> \(ii\) such securities are eligible for settlement through Clearstream Banking S.A. (in the case of Euro-denominated securities) or The Depository Trust Company (in the case of USD-denominated securities); and
>
> \(iii\) such securities are not subject to any lien, charge, pledge, encumbrance, or other security interest (other than any arising under this Agreement or the applicable settlement system rules).

**(b) \"Eligible Corporate Securities\"** means fixed-rate or floating-rate debt securities issued by a corporate issuer (including, for the avoidance of doubt, securities issued by a corporate entity that is not a sovereign or government-guaranteed entity), provided that:

> \(i\) such securities have a long-term issuer credit rating of not less than **BBB+** by S&P or **Baa1** by Moody\'s (or, if rated by both, meeting at least one such threshold at the relevant time of determination);
>
> \(ii\) the residual maturity of such securities does not exceed **ten (10) years** from the relevant Purchase Date;
>
> \(iii\) such securities are eligible for settlement through Clearstream Banking S.A. (in the case of Euro-denominated securities) or The Depository Trust Company (in the case of USD-denominated securities);
>
> \(iv\) such securities are not convertible, exchangeable, or equity-linked;
>
> \(v\) such securities are not subordinated obligations of the issuer; and
>
> \(vi\) such securities are not subject to any lien, charge, pledge, encumbrance, or other security interest (other than any arising under this Agreement or the applicable settlement system rules).

**(c) \"Eligible Collateral\"** means Eligible Sovereign Securities and Eligible Corporate Securities, collectively.

**(d)** Buyer reserves the right, in its sole and reasonable discretion, to refuse to accept any securities proposed by Seller as Purchased Securities or Additional Purchased Securities if, in Buyer\'s reasonable opinion, such securities do not satisfy the eligibility criteria set out in this Section 3 or if market conditions or credit considerations so warrant. Any such refusal shall be communicated to Seller promptly in writing.

**Section 4 --- Haircuts**

**(a) Eligible Sovereign Securities:**

> Haircut Percentage: **2.0%** (the \"**Sovereign Haircut**\").
>
> Application: The Purchase Price for a Transaction in which the Purchased Securities are Eligible Sovereign Securities shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of such Purchased Securities (as of the relevant Purchase Date or, in the case of Additional Purchased Securities, as of the date of transfer) by 1.020.
>
> *Illustrative example:* If the Market Value of Eligible Sovereign Securities is \$100,000,000, the Purchase Price shall be \$100,000,000 ÷ 1.020 = \$98,039,215.69.

**(b) Eligible Corporate Securities:**

> Haircut Percentage: **5.0%** (the \"**Corporate Haircut**\").
>
> Application: The Purchase Price for a Transaction in which the Purchased Securities are Eligible Corporate Securities shall be determined by dividing the Market Value of such Purchased Securities (as of the relevant Purchase Date or, in the case of Additional Purchased Securities, as of the date of transfer) by 1.050.
>
> *Illustrative example:* If the Market Value of Eligible Corporate Securities is \$50,000,000, the Purchase Price shall be \$50,000,000 ÷ 1.050 = \$47,619,047.62.

**(c)** The Haircut Percentages set out in this Section 4 shall apply to the initial pricing of each Transaction and to the valuation of Purchased Securities and Additional Purchased Securities for the purposes of Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance). For the avoidance of doubt, the Haircut Percentage applicable to a Transaction shall be determined by reference to the category of Eligible Collateral into which the relevant Purchased Securities fall at the time of the initial Transaction and shall not change during the life of that Transaction unless the Purchased Securities are substituted in accordance with Paragraph 8 and Annex II, Section 9, in which case the Haircut Percentage applicable to the Alternative Securities shall apply from the date of substitution.

**Section 5 --- Margin Thresholds**

**(a) Delivery Amount (Margin Deficit --- payable by Seller):**

> Margin Threshold: **\$250,000** (two hundred fifty thousand United States Dollars).
>
> No obligation to deliver Additional Purchased Securities or Cash Margin arises unless the Delivery Amount (calculated in the Base Currency on an aggregate net basis across all outstanding Transactions) exceeds \$250,000.

**(b) Return Amount (Margin Excess --- payable by Buyer):**

> Margin Threshold: **\$250,000** (two hundred fifty thousand United States Dollars).
>
> No obligation to return Equivalent Securities or Cash Margin arises unless the Return Amount (calculated in the Base Currency on an aggregate net basis across all outstanding Transactions) exceeds \$250,000.

**(c)** The Margin Thresholds set forth in sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) above apply on an aggregate net basis across all outstanding Transactions. For the avoidance of doubt, the Margin Threshold is not applied on a per-Transaction basis; rather, the aggregate Delivery Amount or Return Amount across all Transactions must exceed the applicable Margin Threshold before any transfer obligation arises.

**Section 6 --- Net Exposure Cap**

**6.1** The aggregate net exposure of Buyer to Seller under all Transactions outstanding at any time shall not exceed **\$1,500,000,000** (one billion five hundred million United States Dollars) (the \"**Net Exposure Cap**\").

**6.2** For the purposes of this Section 6, \"**net exposure**\" means the aggregate Transaction Exposure of all outstanding Transactions (after application of the relevant Haircuts and after deduction of any Cash Margin held by or on behalf of Buyer), calculated in the Base Currency as of the most recent mark-to-market determination.

**6.3** If at any time the net exposure would exceed the Net Exposure Cap (whether as a result of a proposed new Transaction, a decline in the Market Value of Purchased Securities, or otherwise), Buyer shall not be required to enter into any further Transaction and Seller shall, promptly upon notice from Buyer, deliver additional Eligible Collateral or cash in an amount sufficient to reduce the net exposure below the Net Exposure Cap. Failure by Seller to make such delivery within one (1) Business Day of receipt of such notice shall constitute a failure to comply with a Margin Call for the purposes of Paragraph 10(a)(ii).

**6.4** The Net Exposure Cap may be amended from time to time by mutual written agreement of the parties.

**Section 7 --- Margin Call Cut-off Time and Settlement**

**(a)** The margin call cut-off time shall be **10:00 a.m. London time** on a Business Day.

**(b)** If a Margin Call is given and received before 10:00 a.m. London time on a Business Day, the resulting transfer of Additional Purchased Securities, Equivalent Securities, or Cash Margin (as applicable) shall be effected on that **same Business Day**.

**(c)** If a Margin Call is given or received at or after 10:00 a.m. London time on a Business Day, or on a day that is not a Business Day, the resulting transfer shall be effected on the **next following Business Day**.

**(d)** For the purposes of this Section 7, a Margin Call shall be deemed to have been \"received\" at the time of actual receipt by the addressee at the notice details specified in Section 14 of this Annex II. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to respond to and acknowledge receipt of a Margin Call promptly upon receipt.

**Section 8 --- Netting**

Paragraph 7(b) of the Agreement (settlement netting for obligations in the same currency falling due on the same settlement date) is **elected and applicable**. Accordingly, where on any Business Day amounts would otherwise be payable in the same currency and on the same settlement date by each party to the other under this Agreement, such amounts shall be netted in accordance with Paragraph 7(b) of the Agreement, and only the resulting net amount shall be payable by the party owing such amount.

**Section 9 --- Substitution**

**(a)** Seller may, from time to time during the term of any Transaction, request the substitution of Alternative Securities for all or any part of the Purchased Securities in that Transaction. Any such request shall be made in writing (including by electronic mail) and shall specify in reasonable detail the Purchased Securities to be replaced, the proposed Alternative Securities (including ISIN, nominal amount, issuer, coupon, maturity, and credit rating), and the proposed substitution date.

**(b)** Any such substitution shall require the **prior written consent of Buyer**. Buyer may grant, withhold, condition, or delay such consent in its sole and absolute discretion and shall not be required to provide any reason for any refusal. Buyer shall use reasonable efforts to respond to any request for substitution within two (2) Business Days of receipt, but any failure to respond within such period shall not constitute consent.

**(c)** Where Buyer consents, the substitution shall be effected on the Business Day agreed by the parties (or, failing agreement, on the second Business Day following Buyer\'s consent) by simultaneous transfer of the Alternative Securities to Buyer (or to Buyer\'s account at the relevant settlement system) and the Purchased Securities to Seller (or to Seller\'s account at the relevant settlement system), through the applicable settlement system in accordance with Paragraph 6.

**(d)** Alternative Securities must qualify as Eligible Collateral and must satisfy all of the eligibility criteria set out in Section 3 of this Annex II. The Market Value of the Alternative Securities (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) must be at least equal to the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage) as of the close of business on the Business Day immediately preceding the substitution date. If the Alternative Securities fall into a different category of Eligible Collateral than the Purchased Securities being replaced, the Haircut Percentage applicable to the Alternative Securities shall apply from the date of substitution.

**(e)** Upon completion of a substitution, the Alternative Securities shall become the Purchased Securities for all purposes of the relevant Transaction, and the Confirmation for such Transaction shall be deemed to have been amended accordingly. For the avoidance of doubt, the occurrence of a substitution shall not affect the Purchase Date, the Repurchase Date, or the Pricing Rate of the relevant Transaction, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.

**Section 10 --- Cross-Default**

**(a)** For the purposes of Paragraph 10(a)(vi) of the Agreement, a \"**Cross-Default**\" shall occur with respect to a party if:

> \(i\) such party fails to make any payment or delivery when due (after giving effect to any applicable grace period) under one or more agreements or instruments relating to Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold; or
>
> \(ii\) such party\'s Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold is accelerated, or becomes capable of being accelerated, prior to its stated maturity as a result of a default (howsoever described) thereunder; or
>
> \(iii\) any security interest securing Specified Indebtedness in an aggregate amount exceeding the Cross-Default Threshold becomes enforceable and is enforced (including by the taking of possession or the appointment of a receiver, administrative receiver, manager, or other similar officer).

**(b)** \"**Specified Indebtedness**\" means any obligation (whether present or future, contingent or otherwise, as principal or surety or otherwise) in respect of borrowed money. For the avoidance of doubt, Specified Indebtedness includes obligations under loan agreements, credit facilities, overdraft facilities, note purchase agreements, bond indentures, guarantees of borrowed money, and similar instruments, but excludes obligations under this Agreement and under any other agreement that is a GMRA, GMSLA, or ISDA Master Agreement between the parties.

**(c)** \"**Cross-Default Threshold**\" means, with respect to each party, **\$10,000,000** (ten million United States Dollars) (or its equivalent in any other currency, converted into the Base Currency at the spot rate of exchange at the relevant time).

**(d)** For the purposes of determining whether the Cross-Default Threshold has been exceeded, all amounts of Specified Indebtedness in respect of which the relevant event has occurred shall be aggregated (regardless of whether such amounts arise under the same or different agreements or instruments).

**Section 11 --- Act of Insolvency**

**(a)** The definition of \"Act of Insolvency\" shall be as set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, supplemented as follows.

**(b)** **Grace Period: None (zero days).** An Act of Insolvency shall constitute an Event of Default immediately and automatically upon occurrence, without requirement for notice or lapse of any period of time (an \"**ipso facto trigger**\"). For the avoidance of doubt, upon the occurrence of an Act of Insolvency with respect to a party, the other party shall be entitled, without the requirement for any notice to the Defaulting Party, to designate an Early Termination Date in respect of all outstanding Transactions in accordance with Paragraph 10(b).

**(c)** For the avoidance of doubt, and without limiting the definition of Act of Insolvency set out in the 2011 ICMA GMRA, each of the following shall constitute an Act of Insolvency for the purposes of this Agreement:

> \(i\) the appointment of a receiver, administrator, liquidator, conservator, trustee, custodian, or similar official over a party or any material part of its assets, whether by a court of competent jurisdiction, a governmental or regulatory authority, or otherwise;
>
> \(ii\) the filing of any petition, application, or proceeding (whether voluntary or involuntary) seeking any such appointment or seeking any arrangement, reorganisation, composition, readjustment, liquidation, dissolution, winding-up, or similar relief under any applicable insolvency, bankruptcy, receivership, administration, or similar law;
>
> \(iii\) the making of a general assignment for the benefit of creditors;
>
> \(iv\) the admission in writing by a party of its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due;
>
> \(v\) the taking of any corporate or other action by a party in furtherance of any of the foregoing; or
>
> \(vi\) any analogous event or proceeding in any jurisdiction.

**Section 12 --- Repricing / Mini Close-out**

**(a)** Buyer may, at its sole option, elect to reprice any Transaction having an original term or, in the case of an evergreen or rolling Transaction, a then-current term, exceeding sixty (60) calendar days. Such repricing (a \"**Repricing Event**\") may be exercised on the **90th calendar day** following the Purchase Date of the relevant Transaction, or on the anniversary of any prior Repricing Date if the Transaction remains outstanding (each such date, a \"**Repricing Date**\"). If a Repricing Date falls on a day that is not a Business Day, the Repricing Date shall be the next following Business Day.

**(b)** Buyer shall exercise a Repricing Event by delivering written notice to Seller not less than two (2) Business Days prior to the applicable Repricing Date. Such notice shall specify the Transaction to be repriced and the proposed Repricing Date.

**(c)** Upon the occurrence of a Repricing Event:

> \(i\) the original Transaction shall terminate on the Repricing Date as if such date were the Repurchase Date, and Seller shall pay to Buyer the Repurchase Price applicable to the original Transaction as of the Repricing Date;
>
> \(ii\) simultaneously, the parties shall enter into a new Transaction on terms identical to the original Transaction, save that:
>
> \(A\) the Purchase Date of the new Transaction shall be the Repricing Date;
>
> \(B\) the Purchase Price of the new Transaction shall be recalculated based on the Market Value of the Purchased Securities on the Repricing Date (after application of the relevant Haircut Percentage); and
>
> \(C\) the Pricing Rate shall be as agreed by the parties or, failing agreement by 5:00 p.m. London time on the Business Day immediately preceding the Repricing Date, the Pricing Rate applicable to the original Transaction shall continue to apply to the new Transaction;
>
> \(iii\) the close-out amount, if any, arising from the termination of the original Transaction and the simultaneous commencement of the new Transaction shall be calculated as the difference between the Repurchase Price of the original Transaction and the Purchase Price of the new Transaction. Such close-out amount shall be settled in cash on the Repricing Date by the party owing the net amount to the other party.

**(d)** The repricing mechanic set out in this Section 12 does not affect either party\'s rights under Paragraph 4 (Margin Maintenance) or Paragraph 10 (Events of Default). For the avoidance of doubt, the existence of a Repricing Event or the exercise of a Repricing Event shall not relieve either party of its obligations to make margin transfers or to comply with Margin Calls during the period between the date of notice and the Repricing Date.

**(e)** The parties acknowledge that the purpose of the repricing mechanic is to adjust the economic terms of outstanding Transactions to reflect current market conditions and to manage the credit exposure of the parties. The new Transaction entered into on a Repricing Date shall, for all purposes of this Agreement, be treated as a new and separate Transaction.

**Section 13 --- Tax Gross-Up**

**(a)** Paragraph 11(b) of the Agreement (Tax Gross-Up) is **elected and applicable**.

**(b)** If a Tax Payor fails to pay any additional amounts required under Paragraph 11(b), the Tax Payee shall give written notice of such failure to the Tax Payor. The Tax Payor shall have a cure period of **five (5) Business Days** from receipt of such written notice within which to pay the outstanding Tax Gross-Up Amount in full.

**(c)** Failure of the Tax Payor to cure such failure within such five (5) Business Day period shall constitute an **Event of Default** with respect to the Tax Payor, and the Tax Payee may thereafter exercise its rights under Paragraph 10(b) of the Agreement, including the right to designate an Early Termination Date in respect of all outstanding Transactions.

.

**\"Sell Back Price\"** means, in respect of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction, the price at which Equivalent Securities are to be sold by Buyer to Seller on the Repurchase Date, calculated in accordance with the provisions of Part 1 of Annex I.

**\"Seller\"** means, in relation to any Transaction, the party that sells or agrees to sell Securities to the other party on the Purchase Date and agrees to purchase Equivalent Securities from the other party on the Repurchase Date.

**\"Spot Rate\"** means, in respect of any date and any pair of currencies, the prevailing spot exchange rate for the purchase of one currency with another, as determined in good faith by the party making the relevant determination, having regard to the prevailing rates quoted in the relevant foreign exchange market at or about 11:00 a.m. (London time) on such date.

**\"Term\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the period from (and including) the Purchase Date to (but excluding) the Repurchase Date.

**\"Termination\"** means the termination of a Transaction or of this Agreement in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

**\"Transaction Costs\"** means all reasonable costs, charges, fees, expenses, and other amounts (including, without limitation, legal fees and expenses, and costs of any sale or purchase of Securities) incurred by the Non-Defaulting Party by reason of, or in connection with, the enforcement of this Agreement, the exercise of its rights following an Event of Default, or the close-out of any Transaction.

**\"Transaction Exposure\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4(a).

2.2 **Interpretive Provisions.** In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:

> \(a\) references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts are references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts of or to this Agreement;
>
> \(b\) references to a Paragraph include references to each sub-paragraph thereof;
>
> \(c\) words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa;
>
> \(d\) words importing any gender include all genders;
>
> \(e\) references to any statute, regulation, directive, or other legislative provision shall be construed as a reference to such statute, regulation, directive, or provision as the same may be amended, modified, supplemented, or re-enacted from time to time;
>
> \(f\) headings are for ease of reference only and shall not affect the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement; and
>
> \(g\) references to \"including\" shall mean \"including, without limitation.\"

**[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmation; Termination]{.underline}**

**(a) Initiation.** A Transaction may be entered into between the parties on such terms as they may agree. The parties shall, before or at the time of entering into each Transaction, agree on the following terms (to the extent applicable to such Transaction):

> \(i\) the identity and nominal value (or quantity, as applicable) of the Purchased Securities;
>
> \(ii\) the Purchase Date;
>
> \(iii\) the Purchase Price;
>
> \(iv\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is to be an open Transaction, a statement to that effect;
>
> \(v\) the Pricing Rate;
>
> \(vi\) the identification of each party as Buyer or Seller;
>
> \(vii\) any Margin Ratio, Margin Percentage, or other margin terms applicable to the Transaction;
>
> \(viii\) the Sell Back Price (in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction); and
>
> \(ix\) such other terms as the parties may agree to be applicable to such Transaction.

**(b) Confirmation.** Upon entering into a Transaction, the Buyer or Seller (as the parties may agree, or, in the absence of such agreement, the Seller) shall promptly deliver to the other party a written Confirmation setting out the terms of such Transaction. Each Confirmation shall specify the relevant terms agreed under sub-paragraph (a) above and such other details as may be required for the proper recording and settlement of the Transaction. The terms of the Confirmation shall be binding on both parties unless the other party objects in writing promptly upon receipt of such Confirmation, and in any event no later than the close of business on the Business Day following receipt thereof. Failure to deliver or object to a Confirmation shall not, however, invalidate or affect the validity of the Transaction.

**(c) Termination of Transactions.**

> \(i\) Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 10, each Transaction shall terminate on the Repurchase Date upon the payment of the Repurchase Price by Seller and the delivery of Equivalent Securities by Buyer. The obligations of the parties to make such payment and delivery shall be subject to the condition that no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in respect of either party.
>
> \(ii\) In the case of a Transaction that is an open Transaction (i.e., a Transaction for which no fixed Repurchase Date has been specified), either party may terminate such Transaction by giving notice to the other party on or before a particular Business Day, and the Transaction shall terminate on the date that is the number of Business Days\' notice agreed between the parties (or, if no such number has been agreed, two (2) Business Days) following the date of such notice. The party giving such notice shall specify in such notice the date on which the Transaction is to terminate, and such date shall be the Repurchase Date for the purposes of such Transaction.

**(d) Netting of Deliveries.** If on any date Transactions between the same parties call for the delivery of the same Securities by each party to the other, and if the parties have so agreed (whether in Annex II or otherwise), the delivery obligations of each party under such Transactions may be netted so that only the net deliverer shall be obliged to deliver the net amount of such Securities to the other party on such date. The scope and application of delivery netting shall be as elected or specified in Annex II.

**[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**

**(a) Transaction Exposure.** The \"**Transaction Exposure**\" of a party in respect of a Transaction at any time shall be determined as follows:

> \(i\) if the Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable to the Transaction, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time multiplied by the Margin Ratio (or, as the case may be, the Market Value adjusted for the Margin Percentage). The Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall be the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities (adjusted as aforesaid) exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time;
>
> \(ii\) if no Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time, and the Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time.

For the purposes of this sub-paragraph, the Repurchase Price at any time shall be the Purchase Price plus the Price Differential accrued to such time.

**(b) Net Exposure.** The \"**Net Exposure**\" of a party shall be determined by aggregating all Transaction Exposures of that party in respect of all outstanding Transactions between the parties, and setting off against such aggregate any Transaction Exposures of the other party, taking into account the Net Value of Margin Provided by each party. The party whose aggregate exposure (after such set-off and adjustment) is a positive amount shall be the party with the Net Exposure.

**(c) Margin Transfers.** If at any time one party has a Net Exposure in excess of any applicable Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount (each as specified in Annex II), such party may, by notice to the other party, require the other party to make a Margin Transfer to it in an amount sufficient to eliminate the Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount). A Margin Transfer may be effected by:

> \(i\) the transfer of Cash Margin in the currency specified in Annex II or otherwise agreed; or
>
> \(ii\) the transfer of Margin Securities of a type and description acceptable to the party making the demand and falling within the categories of eligible Margin Securities specified in Annex II; or
>
> \(iii\) such combination of Cash Margin and Margin Securities as the parties may agree.

**(d) Valuation of Margin Securities.** For the purpose of determining the value of any Margin Securities transferred or to be transferred, such Margin Securities shall be valued at their Market Value as at the relevant date, subject to the application of any haircut or discount percentage specified in Annex II in relation to Margin Securities of that type. The value of any Margin Securities after the application of such haircut shall be the value attributed to such Margin Securities for the purposes of calculating Net Exposure.

**(e) Cash Margin.** Cash Margin shall be denominated in such currency as the parties may agree or as specified in Annex II. Interest shall accrue on Cash Margin at the rate and on the basis specified in Annex II, or, if no such rate is specified, at the overnight interbank rate prevailing from time to time in the principal financial centre of the currency of the Cash Margin. The party holding Cash Margin shall pay interest thereon to the party that transferred such Cash Margin in accordance with the terms elected in Annex II.

**(f) Return of Excess Margin.** If at any time the Net Exposure of a party to whom a Margin Transfer has been made is reduced below the Threshold Amount (if any), or if the party that previously had the Net Exposure no longer has such exposure, the party holding the excess Margin Securities or Cash Margin shall, upon demand by the other party, transfer to the other party Equivalent Margin Securities and/or Cash Margin, as the case may be, in an amount sufficient to reduce the Net Value of Margin Provided to an amount not exceeding the current Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount).

**(g) Timing of Margin Transfers.** Any Margin Transfer demanded in accordance with this Paragraph 4 shall be made by the close of business on the next Business Day following the date of the demand or such other time as the parties may agree. If the parties have agreed a different settlement cycle for Margin Transfers in Annex II, such agreed cycle shall apply.

**(h) Disputes Regarding Margin.** If the parties disagree as to the Market Value of any Securities, Cash Margin, or the amount of any Net Exposure, they shall use reasonable efforts to resolve such disagreement in good faith. Pending resolution of any such dispute:

> \(i\) the party upon whom a demand has been made shall transfer the undisputed amount of margin to the other party; and
>
> \(ii\) the parties shall seek to agree upon the Market Value of the relevant Securities by reference to independent pricing sources, and, failing such agreement, by reference to quotations obtained from not fewer than two independent market-makers or dealers in the relevant Securities. The average of such quotations shall be the Market Value for the purposes of this Paragraph 4.

**[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**

**(a) Buyer\'s Obligation.** Where Income is paid in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, Buyer shall, on the relevant Income Payment Date, or on such other date as the parties may agree, pay to Seller an amount equal to the amount of such Income as would have been received by Seller had the Purchased Securities not been the subject of such Transaction.

**(b) Timing of Income Payment.** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the amount referred to in sub-paragraph (a) above shall be paid on the date on which such Income is paid in respect of the relevant Securities by the issuer or the relevant paying agent. If Income is paid on a day that is not a Business Day, payment shall be made on the next following Business Day.

**(c) Manufactured Payments.** Where any payment under this Paragraph 5 constitutes a \"manufactured payment\" or \"manufactured dividend\" or similar payment for tax or regulatory purposes, the following provisions shall apply:

> \(i\) if Buyer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct any amount from such payment on account of tax, Buyer shall make the relevant withholding or deduction and shall pay to Seller the net amount remaining after such withholding or deduction;
>
> \(ii\) unless otherwise agreed in Annex II, Buyer shall not be required to gross up or pay any additional amounts to compensate Seller for any such withholding or deduction; and
>
> \(iii\) the parties shall cooperate in good faith to minimise any such withholding or deduction and to provide such forms, certificates, or documentation as may be reasonably required by applicable law or regulation.

**(d) Set-off of Income.** Buyer may set off any amount due from Buyer to Seller under this Paragraph 5 against any amount due from Seller to Buyer under any Transaction, provided that both amounts are due and payable on the same date and are denominated in the same currency.

**(e) Buy/Sell Back Transactions.** In the case of Buy/Sell Back Transactions, the treatment of Income shall be as provided in Part 1 of Annex I. The Sell Back Price shall be adjusted to reflect any Income received or receivable during the Term, in accordance with the formula set out in Part 1 of Annex I, and the provisions of this Paragraph 5 shall apply only to the extent specified in Annex I and subject to any elections made in Annex II.

**[Paragraph 6 --- Payment and Transfer]{.underline}**

**(a) Payments.** All payments to be made under this Agreement shall be made in freely available, immediately available, same-day funds in the relevant Contractual Currency. Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, all payments shall be made not later than the time customary in the relevant market for payments in the Contractual Currency on the date on which such payment is due.

**(b) Deliveries of Securities.** All deliveries of Securities to be made under this Agreement shall be made through the clearing system or settlement system agreed between the parties in the relevant Confirmation or in Annex II, or, if no such system is specified, through such system as is customary for the settlement of transactions in such Securities. Deliveries may be made on a free of payment basis or on a delivery versus payment basis, as specified in the relevant Confirmation or as otherwise agreed.

**(c) Set-off and Payment Netting.** Where on any date amounts are due from each party to the other under two or more Transactions, and such amounts are denominated in the same currency, the parties may (and, if so elected in Annex II, shall) net such amounts so that only the net amount shall be payable by the party owing the larger aggregate amount. Each party\'s obligation to pay amounts under this Agreement on any date shall, to the extent of such netting, be discharged and replaced by the obligation of one party to pay the net amount to the other.

**(d) Default Interest.** If either party fails to pay any amount when due under this Agreement, interest shall accrue on such unpaid amount from (and including) the date on which such amount was due to (but excluding) the date of actual payment, at a rate per annum equal to the overnight cost of funding of the Non-Defaulting Party or the party to whom such amount is owed, as reasonably determined by such party, or at such other rate as may be agreed in Annex II. Such interest shall be payable on demand and shall be calculated on the basis of a year of 360 days (or 365 days, as applicable to the relevant currency) and the actual number of days elapsed.

**(e) Currency Conversion.** Where it is necessary for the purposes of this Agreement to convert any amount from one currency to another, such conversion shall be effected at the Spot Rate on the relevant date or, if no Spot Rate is available on such date, on the most recent date on which a Spot Rate is available, and any resulting amount shall be expressed in the Base Currency for the purpose of aggregation, comparison, or netting under this Agreement.

**[Paragraph 7 --- Contractual Currency]{.underline}**

**(a)** Each payment obligation arising under this Agreement shall be satisfied by payment in the Contractual Currency. If, for any reason, a party receives payment in a currency other than the Contractual Currency, and the amount received by such party, upon conversion to the Contractual Currency at the Spot Rate on the date of receipt, is less than the amount due in the Contractual Currency, the paying party shall remain liable for the shortfall. If the amount received upon such conversion exceeds the amount due, the receiving party shall not be obliged to refund the excess, but may, at its discretion, credit such excess against future payment obligations of the paying party.

**(b)** The obligation to pay any shortfall arising under sub-paragraph (a) above shall constitute a separate and independent obligation of the paying party, enforceable irrespective of any judgment or order obtained or made in respect of the original payment obligation or any other obligation under this Agreement. This obligation shall not be affected by any judgment or order that may be expressed or converted into a currency other than the Contractual Currency.

**(c)** For the purposes of this Paragraph 7, the conversion rate to be applied shall be the Spot Rate on the date on which conversion is made. Where multiple conversions are required, each such conversion shall be effected at the Spot Rate prevailing on the date of the relevant conversion.

**[Paragraph 8 --- Substitution]{.underline}**

**(a) Right to Request Substitution.** Subject to the terms of this Paragraph 8, Seller may at any time during the Term of a Transaction request Buyer to accept substitute securities (\"**New Purchased Securities**\") in place of all or any part of the existing Purchased Securities, and Buyer shall not unreasonably withhold or delay its consent to such substitution. Buyer shall be entitled to refuse consent to a substitution if the proposed New Purchased Securities are not reasonably acceptable to Buyer having regard to the creditworthiness of the issuer, the liquidity of the market for such securities, the type or category of securities, or any other commercially reasonable ground.

**(b) Mechanics of Substitution.** If Buyer consents to a substitution, the substitution shall be effected by the simultaneous transfer by Seller to Buyer of the New Purchased Securities and the transfer by Buyer to Seller of the existing Purchased Securities (or such portion thereof as is being substituted), or by such other arrangement as the parties may agree. Upon such substitution, all references in this Agreement and in the relevant Confirmation to \"Purchased Securities\" shall, in respect of the relevant Transaction, be deemed to refer to the New Purchased Securities, and the terms of the Transaction shall be adjusted accordingly.

**(c) Equivalent Value.** The New Purchased Securities shall have a Market Value as at the date of substitution that is substantially the same as (or, if so agreed between the parties, not less than) the Market Value of the Purchased Securities they replace, determined as at the same date. If the Market Value of the New Purchased Securities is less than the Market Value of the Purchased Securities being replaced, Seller shall transfer additional Securities or Cash Margin in an amount sufficient to eliminate the shortfall, or the parties shall agree such other adjustments to the Transaction as are appropriate.

**(d) Effect on Margin.** Following any substitution, the margin obligations of the parties under Paragraph 4 shall be recalculated by reference to the Market Value of the New Purchased Securities. Any Margin Transfer demand outstanding prior to such substitution shall be adjusted accordingly, and any Margin Transfer already made shall be taken into account in the recalculated margin position.

**(a) Power and Authority.** Each party represents and warrants to the other party (on the date of this Agreement and as at each date specified in sub-paragraph (f) below) that it has the power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement and each Transaction under this Agreement, and to perform its obligations hereunder and thereunder.

**(e) Title.** Seller represents and warrants to Buyer, in respect of each Transaction, that at the time of transfer of Purchased Securities to Buyer on the Purchase Date, Seller has the full and unqualified right to sell and transfer such Securities free and clear of any lien, charge, claim, security interest, encumbrance, right of set-off, or any other adverse interest or claim of any third party.

**(f) Repetition.** The representations and warranties made by each party under this Paragraph 9 shall be deemed to be repeated by such party on each Purchase Date, on each date on which a Transaction is outstanding, and on each date on which a Margin Transfer is made or received.

**[Paragraph 10 --- Events of Default; Remedies]{.underline}**

**(a) Events of Default.** Each of the following events shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\" with respect to a party (the \"**Defaulting Party**\"):

> \(i\) **Failure to Pay Purchase Price or Repurchase Price.** Buyer fails to pay the Purchase Price on the Purchase Date or Seller fails to pay the Repurchase Price on the Repurchase Date, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);

> \(ii\) **Failure to Deliver Securities.** Seller fails to deliver the Purchased Securities on the Purchase Date or Buyer fails to deliver Equivalent Securities on the Repurchase Date, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);
>
> \(iii\) **Failure to Pay Income.** Buyer fails to pay any amount due under Paragraph 5 (Income Payments) when due, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);

> \(iv\) **Failure to Make Margin Transfer.** A party fails to make a Margin Transfer as required under Paragraph 4 when due, and such failure is not remedied within the number of Business Days specified as the cure period in Annex II (or, if no such period is specified, on or before the next Business Day following notice from the Non-Defaulting Party);
>
> \(v\) **Act of Insolvency.** An Act of Insolvency occurs in respect of either party;
>
> \(vi\s Agreement in favour of a central bank or monetary authority, subject to applicable law.

**(b) Termination of Agreement.** Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not fewer than thirty (30) days\' prior written notice to the other party, provided that:

> \(ii\) all obligations of each party to the other under this Agreement (including, without limitation, payment and delivery obligations, margin obligations, and obligations in respect of Transaction Costs and interest) have been fully discharged; and

> \(iii\) no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in respect of either party.
